system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"huge shoutout to Rick B. of the support team today! He solved my problem quickly and easily and I didn't get to say thank you!"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"<USER> Hey Heather! Thanks for your kind words - we'll make sure to pass them on to the right team. If you need anything else, let us know 😉"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Incorrect name used; should match customer's name or be generic."}
